integrity: Complete self-contained analytic proof with finite sanity checks; no claim of independent audit, exhaustive literature coverage, or unrestricted universality.
scientific_limitations: Haar-uniform central codimension-one slices only; fixed coordinate directions; non-sharp mean-square bound; no result for all directions or the total vertex-count distribution. Historical one-edge and total mean formulas are prior work.
title: Direction-resolved half-normal fluctuations of random central cube sections
